title: Yellow Roasted Japanese Chicken Yakitori
description: A romantic Japanese dish featuring roasted chicken, basil leaves, and a creamy coconut sauce, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe is raw-friendly and easy to make.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut cream, soy sauce, honey, grated ginger, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with sesame oil.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, mix the chopped basil leaves into the remaining marinade.
After the chicken has cooked, brush the basil marinade onto the chicken pieces.
Serve the yellow roasted Japanese chicken yakitori hot, garnished with additional basil leaves if desired.
